name: application-photo-exif-panel
title: Photo EXIF Panel
description: Photography EXIF metadata panel: a luminance histogram above camera, lens, focal length, aperture, shutter speed, ISO, and dimensions rows.
useWhen: Building a photo management, editing, or portfolio tool that needs to surface a shot's capture details.
You need a histogram alongside metadata rows in a compact sidebar-style panel.
Distinct from a generic Media component, which displays the image itself, rather than its embedded capture metadata and tonal distribution.
avoidWhen: You just need to display the photo, not its metadata — use a plain image or Media component instead.
EXIF data isn't available or relevant — a simpler caption is enough.
responsiveBehavior: The histogram SVG uses preserveAspectRatio="none" so it stretches to the panel's full width at any container size; metadata rows keep label and value on one line via flex justify-between.
accessibility: The histogram SVG carries role="img" and a descriptive aria-label summarizing its shape (e.g. mid-tone weighted with a highlight peak), since the visual chart alone conveys no text alternative.
Metadata is marked up as a definition list (dl/dt/dd), giving assistive tech a clear label/value relationship for each row.
